name: Band Monster Walk
steps: Place a loop resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees and drop into a shallow athletic squat with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, lift your chest, and keep your toes pointing forward.
Step forward and slightly outward on a diagonal with one foot, maintaining steady tension in the band.
Follow with a forward diagonal step on the opposite leg, continuing to alternate legs while keeping your hips level.
tips: Keep your feet wide enough on every step so the band stays taut throughout.
Prevent your knees from collapsing inward toward each other as you step.
